description: This file contains constant definitions, struct declarations, and class definitions related to 3GPP TS ASN.1 RRC NR protocol for 5G NR, including measurement configurations, resource configurations, and reference signal info, specific to the 'common.h' header in the 'ocudu' ASN.1 RRC NR implementation.

classes.name: subcarrier_spacing_opts
classes.description: Enumerated options for subcarrier spacing in NR.

classes.name: serving_cell_and_bwp_id_r17_s
classes.description: Structure representing serving cell and BWP IDs for R17.

classes.name: plmn_id_s
classes.description: Structure representing PLMN identity with MCC and MNC.

classes.name: srs_periodicity_and_offset_c
classes.description: Choice structure for SRS periodicity and offset.

classes.name: ref_sig_c_
classes.description: Choice structure for reference signal (SSB, CSI-RS, SRS).

classes.name: spatial_relation_info_pdc_r17_s
classes.description: Structure for spatial relation info in PDCCH for R17.

classes.name: srs_pos_resources_r16_s
classes.description: Structure for SRS position resources in R16.

classes.name: srs_pos_res_ap_r16_s
classes.description: Structure for SRS position resources for Aperiodic in R16.

classes.name: srs_pos_res_sp_r16_s
classes.description: Structure for SRS position resources for Semi-persistent in R16.

classes.name: srs_all_pos_res_r16_s
classes.description: Aggregate structure for all position resources in R16.
